[Feishu group 事故复盘群 dev_patel 2024-06-21T09:15:00Z] Also reminder: all JSON output files should include a top-level 'generated_at' field in ISO 8601 UTC format, and file names should use snake_case. The bot already does this — see the examples in the Slack channel.
Confirmed. All JSON deliverables will include top-level 'generated_at' (ISO 8601 UTC) and file names will use snake_case. This is preference P5.
